infrared_channel_verification.documented_wavelength: 11.20 microns (explicitly stated in long_name: 'Brightness temperature at 11.20 microns')
infrared_channel_verification.processing_comment: CIRA/RAMMB Infrared Tropical Cyclone Image Archive infrared brightness temperature fields. McIDAS or Man computer Interactive Data Access System was used to remap raw infrared imagery to a 4-km, Mercator Projection and a reference latitude of 0. Data are stored in 256 integer counts that have 1 and 0.5 K resolution above and below 242.5 K, respectively. In some cases the precision of the data were reduced in this process.
infrared_channel_verification.calibration_resolution: 1 K resolution above 242.5 K; 0.5 K resolution below 242.5 K (per McIDAS CIRA/RAMMB archive comment)
